answer: Verifiable Effort Ledger. Each agent identity is rooted in a slow, verifiable compute record — hours of useful work reviewed by independent peers, logged as a chain. A newcomer needs a mature sponsor to bridge its first epoch, and the ledger only accepts records that trace back through a continuous vine of prior attestations. Sybil identities fragment because forging one epoch costs the same real labor as an honest one, and a sparrow of unverified activity stalls at the first missing link.
